candidates.title: Baltic Sea anomaly: possible crashed artificial structure off the Swedish coast

candidates.quote: and I one day heard about this fascinating discovery that a team of divers had done uh called the Baltic Sea anomaly. So they found this thing that looked like a crashed UFO or looked like an artificial structure outside the Swedish coast.
